kids: Walk through the twinkling garden lights
about: Christmas Nights at Berns Middletown is a two evening kickoff to the Christmas season at a garden property on Greentree Drive in Middletown.
The City of Middletown lists the event on its community calendar with free admission.
It runs on Friday, November 27 and Saturday, November 28, from 5 to 7 PM each night.
Guests enter through the garden gates into grounds strung with twinkling lights.
Fresh greenery decorates the paths and buildings for the season.
The poinsettia Christmas tree is the centerpiece and the host calls it famous.
Santa himself is part of both evenings, so children can see him without waiting for December.
The host invites families who come every year and families who are starting a new tradition.
Because it is a garden, the walk is outdoors and warm layers are a good idea for the evening chill.
The two night format gives families a backup date if the first night is not possible.
faq: When is Christmas Nights at Berns Middletown in 2026?
Friday, November 27 and Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 5 to 7 PM each night.
Where is it?
Berns Middletown, 825 Greentree Dr, Middletown, OH 45044.
What does it cost?
The City of Middletown lists it as free.
Will Santa be there?
Yes. Santa appears on both evenings.
What is there to see?
Twinkling lights, fresh greenery and the poinsettia Christmas tree.
Is it indoors?
The event is in the garden, so plan for outdoor weather.
Who lists the event?
The City of Middletown community calendar.

kids: Write a letter to Santa in his workshop
site: Sunday, Nov 29, 9 AM or 11 AM seating
about: Bridgewater Event Center in Powell opens its doors for a family Breakfast with Santa and Holiday Market on Sunday, November 29, 2026.
Guests choose a 9 AM or 11 AM breakfast seating when they reserve through the center's Square ticket link.
The buffet lists pancakes, eggs, bacon, pastries, coffee and cocoa.
Santa is in the room, and the center invites families to snap their own photos with a phone or camera.
A Santa's workshop corner offers festive activities and a spot for children to write letters to Santa.
A holiday craft market with local vendors runs from 9 AM to 1 PM and is included with every breakfast ticket.
Tickets are $25 for adults and $15 for children, and advance reservations are required.
Guests can bring a new, unwrapped toy or a gift card for the donation bins that support the Delaware County Veterans Toy Drive.
For check in, bring the order confirmation email or the name used for the reservation.
The center is at 10561 Sawmill Parkway, and its phone number is on the event page for ticket questions.
faq: When is Breakfast with Santa at Bridgewater in 2026?
Sunday, November 29, 2026, with seatings at 9 AM and 11 AM.
Where is it?
Bridgewater Event Center, 10561 Sawmill Pkwy, Powell, OH 43065.

Adults are $25 and children are $15.

Yes. Advance reservations are required through the center's Square ticket page.

Pancakes, eggs, bacon, pastries, coffee and cocoa.
Is the holiday market included?
Yes. The craft market from 9 AM to 1 PM is included with a breakfast ticket.

Yes. Families take their own photos with a phone or camera.
